events.description: High volume of failed login attempts from a single IP address indicating an automated brute force or credential stuffing attack.
events.action: Block the source IP, enforce multi-factor authentication, and reset credentials for targeted accounts.

events.description: An internal host at IP 10.0.0.55 performed an unusually large data transfer of 15.5 GB, indicating potential data breach, insider threat, or compromised account.
events.action: Isolate IP 10.0.0.55 from the network, revoke associated user credentials, and audit accessed data repositories.

events.description: An internal IP address (172.16.0.200) conducted a port scan across 1000 ports, indicating potential network discovery, lateral movement preparation, or a compromised host.
events.action: Isolate the source IP (172.16.0.200) from the network, inspect running processes on the host, and verify if an authorized vulnerability scan was scheduled.
